summary: Petrobras filed a routine Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Petrobras Netherlands B.V. signed eight Production Sharing Contracts with the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire and PETROCI Holding covering offshore exploration blocks CI-513, CI-600 through CI-603, CI-605, CI-701 and CI-702. Petrobras holds 90% as operator; PETROCI holds 10%. The filing states no price, premium, close date, break fee or board recommendation, and it is an ordinary upstream acreage acquisition rather than a change-of-control transaction.
